data.seriesDescription: Proportion of urban population living in inadequate housing (%)
data.source: Eurostat- The Statistical Office of the European Union (DG-ESTAT). Distribution of population by housing cost burden - EU-SILC Survey (Survey on Income and Living Conditions).  (Available at: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/en/web/main/data/database). (Date of last update: 30 April 2025).
footnotes: Proportion of urban population living in inadequate housing (net monthly expenditure on housing exceeding 40% of the total monthly income of the household) (%). footnotes: Proportion of urban population living in inadequate housing (net monthly expenditure on housing exceeding 30% of the total monthly income of the household) (%). The housing cost overburden rate is the percentage of the population living in households where the total housing costs ('net' of housing allowances) represent more than 30 % of disposable income ('net' of housing allowances).
